ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is part of complaint about complaint CMOS, which prevents users from updating the CAC fields only when if a specific combination is in place
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') || ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Provisionally Closed')) && ( NOT( ISPICKVAL(Type, '9') && ISPICKVAL(IDR_Subsequent_Issue__c, '61')) || NOT( ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c, '9') && ISPICKVAL(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_2__c, '61')) || NOT( ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c, '9') && ISPICKVAL(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_2__c, '61')) ) && ( ISCHANGED(Is_this_a_complaint_about_a_complaint__c) || ISCHANGED(CAC_Sub_Category__c) || ISCHANGED(Review_Outcome__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update Complaint About Complaint fields (Internal Is this a complaint about a complaint, CAC Sub Category or Review Outcom) unless the status is closed and Issue type is service quality and sub issue type is Failure to respond to complaint
